queries.text:
let t =
baseTransactions
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| project timestamp,
    Stage,
    Result,
    TransactionKey,
    StoreNo,
    POSTerminalNo,
    TransactionNo,
    TableNo,
    FailureReason,
    eventId,
    alUserId,
    message
;
//
// Step 1: Get the latest finish event per TransactionKey
//
let finishedEvents = t
| where Stage == 'Applied'
    and Result == 'Success'
| summarize MaxFinishTime = max(timestamp) by TransactionKey
;
//
// Step 2: Get all error events
//
let errorEvents = t
| where Result == 'Error'
;
//
// Step 3 - Get POS Mapping table for possible filtering
//
let posMapping = pos_mapping
| where user_telemetry_id has_any (param_userTelemetryId)
| where pos_name has_any (param_posName)
| where pos_terminal_no has_any (param_posTerminalNo)
;
//
// Step 4: Join filtered errorEvents with posMapping to allow pos_name filtering
//
errorEvents
| join kind=leftanti finishedEvents on TransactionKey
| extend TransactionStatus = case(
    (Stage == 'Posted'), "Transaction has been posted in POS but not yet sent to Service Bus/Azure Storage",
    (Stage == 'Enqueued' and Result == 'Error'), "Transaction has not been sent to Service Bus/Azure Storage due to an error",
    (Stage == 'Enqueued' and Result == 'Success'), "Transaction has been successfully sent to Service Bus/Azure Storage",
    (Stage == 'Applied' and Result == 'Error'), "Transaction has been posted in POS and sent to Service Bus/Azure Storage but failed to be applied in Headoffice",
    (Stage == 'Applied' and Result == 'Success'), "Transaction has been successfully applied in Headoffice",
    "Unknown status"
)
| project timestamp
, StoreNo
, POSTerminalNo
, TransactionNo
, TransactionStatus
, Stage
, Result
, FailureReason
, alUserId
, TableNo
, message
, eventId
| sort by timestamp desc

let trans_replic_eventId = 'AL10012870';
let t =
  traces
  | where customDimensions.eventId == trans_replic_eventId
  | where customDimensions.aadTenantId has_any (param_aadTenantId)
  | extend eventId = tostring(customDimensions.eventId)
  | extend alUserId = tostring(customDimensions.alUserId)
  | extend alSessionId = tostring(customDimensions.alSessionId)
  | extend Stage = tostring(customDimensions.alStage)
  | extend message = tostring(message)
  | extend Result = tostring(customDimensions.alResult)
  | extend TransactionKey = tostring(customDimensions.alTransactionKey)
  | extend TableNo = tostring(customDimensions.alTableNo)
  | extend FailureReason = tostring(customDimensions.alFailureReason)
  | extend ErrorText = tostring(customDimensions.alErrorText)
  | extend StoreNo =
      case(
          message == 'OnAfterSendTransByExternalStorageMessage',
          toupper(extract(@"s([^-]+)-", 1, tostring(customDimensions.alPacketPrefix))),
          tostring(customDimensions.alStoreNo)
      )
  | extend POSTerminalNo =
      case(
          message == 'OnAfterSendTransByExternalStorageMessage',
          toupper(extract(@"-p([^-]+)-", 1, tostring(customDimensions.alPacketPrefix))),
          tostring(customDimensions.alPOSTerminalNo)
      )
  | extend TransactionNo =
      case(
          message == 'OnAfterSendTransByExternalStorageMessage',
        toint(extract(@"-t([^-]+)-", 1, tostring(customDimensions.alPacketPrefix))),
          toint(customDimensions.alTransactionNo)
      )
  | extend aadTenantId = tostring(customDimensions.aadTenantId)
  | extend environmentName = tostring(customDimensions.environmentName)
  | extend environmentType = tostring(customDimensions.environmentType)
  | extend userTelemetryId = case(
      // user telemetry id was introduced in the platform in version 20.0
      toint(substring(customDimensions.componentVersion,0,2)) >= 20, user_Id,
      'N/A'
  )
;
t

traces
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend _aadTenantId = tostring(customDimensions.aadTenantId)
| distinct _aadTenantId
| where _aadTenantId <> ''
| project ["AAD Tenant Id"] = _aadTenantId

traces
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where customDimensions.aadTenantId has_any (param_aadTenantId)
| extend componentVersion = tostring(customDimensions.componentVersion)
| extend versionMajor = toint(substring(componentVersion, 0, 2))
| extend usertelemetryId = case(versionMajor >= 20, user_Id, "N/A")
| where usertelemetryId != "N/A" and isnotempty(usertelemetryId)
| distinct usertelemetryId
| project ["User Telemetry Id"] = usertelemetryId
